projects.title: Terminal-Based Rogue-like Dungeon Crawler
projects.summary: A full-featured turn-based rogue-like dungeon crawler developed entirely in C for Unix terminals, featuring procedurally generated levels and rich ASCII animations.
highlights: Implemented procedural level generation algorithms (Binary Space Partitioning / Cellular Automata) for unique maps
Turn-based state machine, field-of-view (FOV) raycasting, and enemy AI pathfinding
Rigorous low-level memory management and pointer arithmetic with zero memory leaks verified by Valgrind

projects.title: 20 Minutes Till Dawn - 2D Survival Horde Shooter
projects.summary: A fast-paced 2D rogue-lite horde-survival action game built in Java with full graphical user interface, inspired by '20 Minutes Till Dawn'.
highlights: Clean object-oriented architecture employing Factory, Strategy, and Observer design patterns for modular weapons and enemies
Efficient spatial partitioning (spatial hashing) for broad-phase collision detection with hundreds of concurrent on-screen entities
Custom particle rendering pipeline, dynamic camera tracking, and upgrade progression system running smoothly at 60 FPS

projects.title: Multiplayer Stardew Valley Farming Simulator
projects.summary: A rich 2D graphical farming and life simulation game developed in Java, featuring real-time synchronous multiplayer support for up to 4 concurrent players over a network.
highlights: Engineered a dedicated multi-threaded TCP client-server architecture with state synchronization to eliminate game state desyncs
Full simulation mechanics: grid-based farming, dynamic crop growth timers, NPC interactions, inventory management, and tile-map rendering
Custom packet serialization protocol facilitating smooth 4-player cooperative gameplay across a local or wide area network

projects.title: Dual-Issue Mini SuperScalar Processor Architecture
projects.summary: Architecture design and RTL simulation of a 32-bit dual-issue superscalar pipelined processor capable of fetching, decoding, and issuing up to two instructions per clock cycle.
highlights: Designed a dual-issue execution pipeline with hazard detection units for RAW, WAR, and WAW data dependencies
Integrated dynamic forwarding logic and branch hazard mitigation to maximize Instruction-Level Parallelism (ILP)
Verified processor functionality and throughput improvements using comprehensive testbenches running real assembly program workloads
